name: v0_live_current
theory: Control: the battery Helix uses live today (direction as up/down/neutral against a neutral band, plus regime and long/short setup scores), adapted only where the live state has order-book fields the replay cannot rebuild; the hourly question exactly as the live hourly test asks it.

direction.instructions: Where will the price be {H} minutes from now, compared with now? `neutral_band_{H}m_bps` is the threshold; `expected_move_{H}m_bps` is the usual size of a move over that time.

criteria.up: The price ends more than `neutral_band_{H}m_bps` above where it is now
criteria.down: The price ends more than `neutral_band_{H}m_bps` below where it is now
criteria.neutral: The price ends within `neutral_band_{H}m_bps` of where it is now

regime.instructions: Which regime describes this market right now, judging by the returns and volatility in the state

criteria.trending: Returns over 5 to 60 minutes point the same way and price keeps extending in that direction
criteria.mean_reverting: Price oscillates around a stable level; short moves keep reversing
criteria.high_vol: Large moves both ways; `vol_ratio_15m_vs_4h` well above 1
criteria.crisis: Disorderly: violent moves with `vol_ratio_15m_vs_4h` far above 1

long_setup.instructions: How favourable is opening a LONG right now, a bet that price rises over the next 15 minutes
criteria: Against: price is falling and the recent bars are mostly down
Weak: mixed signals; nothing in the trend, bars or volume supports a rise
Supported: short-term trend, bars and volume lean towards a rise
Strong: trend, bars and volume all clearly point up

short_setup.instructions: How favourable is opening a SHORT right now, a bet that price falls over the next 15 minutes
criteria: Against: price is rising and the recent bars are mostly up
Weak: mixed signals; nothing in the trend, bars or volume supports a fall
Supported: short-term trend, bars and volume lean towards a fall
Strong: trend, bars and volume all clearly point down

above.instructions: When `minutes_to_expiry` minutes have passed, will the price be above `strike_{S}`?

criteria.false: The price ends at or below `strike_{S}`
